name: Return to Dust
source:
How would you decide to spend the longest night of the year? Do you have someone you can trust all sorts of things? Sit down. Listen. Our story begins.

[From [url=https://darkpixy.itch.io/return-to-dust]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一年中最长的夜晚，你打算如何度过？你有可以倾诉一切的人吗？坐下吧，听我说。故事就此开始。

[摘自[url=https://darkpixy.itch.io/return-to-dust]Itch.io[/url]]
